findings.detail: The extracted pct_of_net_assets sum 244.2789 is inconsistent with the December 31, 2022 investment portfolio total of 215.60% and instead aligns with the prior-period cash-inclusive schedule total of 244.38%.

rationale: PCT01 is an aggregate pct_of_net_assets check. The filing's December 31, 2022 investment schedule gives Total Investment Portfolio fair value as 215.60% of net assets, and the cash-inclusive 2022 total is only 221.56%. The flagged observed sum of 244.2789165470761 does not match the 2022 anchor and is close to the December 31, 2021 cash-inclusive total of 244.38%, indicating a comparative-period leak into the 2022 extraction rather than a valid current-period total.
